comments.author: DiNozzo
comments.body:
Masamune is famous as a gay Daimyo (lord).
When he heard a rumour that his man Sakujuro slept with other man, DATE blamed him for the affair in public.
Sakujuro wrote to DATE a letter with blood-writing, sweaering innocence.
After the he was proved to be innocent, DATE replied to him, apologizing and asking for forgiveness.
